[FACT] User has been busy lately and has been relying on food delivery services.  
[FACT] User found a food delivery service called Fresh Fusion that offers great pre-made meals.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for healthy recipe ideas for lunch.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested healthy lunch recipe ideas including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Grilled Chicken and Avocado Salad: Mixed greens topped with grilled chicken, sliced avocado, cherry tomatoes, and a citrus vinaigrette.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Quinoa and Black Bean Salad: Cooked quinoa mixed with black beans, diced veggies (bell peppers, onions, tomatoes), and balsamic vinaigrette.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Turkey and Avocado Wrap: Whole-grain wrap with hummus, sliced turkey breast, avocado, lettuce, and tomato.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Grilled Chicken and Veggie Sandwich: Grilled chicken breast on whole-grain bread with roasted veggies (zucchini, bell peppers, onions) and sweet potato fries.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Lentil Soup: Simmered lentils with diced veggies (carrots, celery, onions) and spices, served with whole-grain bread or a green salad.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Tomato and Spinach Soup: Blended canned tomatoes with fresh spinach, garlic, and low-sodium chicken broth, served with whole-grain crackers or crusty bread.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Korean-Style Chicken and Veggies: Marinated chicken breast in a Korean-inspired sauce (gochujang, soy sauce, honey) grilled with roasted veggies (broccoli, carrots, bell peppers), served with brown rice or cauliflower rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Indian-Style Lentil and Veggie Bowl: Cooked lentils mixed with sautéed veggies (onions, bell peppers, tomatoes) and Indian spices, served over brown rice or with whole-grain naan.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Overnight Oats: Rolled oats mixed with milk, nuts, seeds, or fruit in a jar, refrigerated overnight.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Quesadilla: Whole-grain tortilla filled with shredded veggies (zucchini, carrots, beans), cheese, and beans, cooked until crispy, served with salsa or guacamole.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised to balance reliance on delivery services with home-cooked meals for better nutrition.
